review.notes: The behavioural content of the ruling is the state test: the era version evaluates a battle destruction on the destroyed Winged Beast's CURRENT state at the end of the battle (still in the Monster Zone, still face-up), whereas the modern version evaluates its PREVIOUS state at the destruction event. Text lineage is cosmetic and trailing, so it is recorded here rather than as a change entry: v0 (FET-EN032, 2005-03-01) -> v1 (DR3-EN152, 2006-11-25) drops the redundant 'As long as this card remains face-up on the field' clause and adopts 'this card gains 500 ATK'; both scripts register the ATK-gain effect from the Monster Zone regardless, and the remaining diff line (RESET_EVENT| vs RESET_EVENT+ RESETS_STANDARD) is the same value. Per-card ruling rather than engine: no rule-profile flag can add a second effect on a different event code.

event.historical_text: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, each time a Winged Beast-Type monster(s) on your side of the field is destroyed, increase the ATK of this card by 500 points.
event.summary: Era trigger timing, not a text erratum: the GOAT script splits the ATK gain in two. The original destruction effect gains 'not c:IsReason(REASON_BATTLE)' so it now covers only non-battle destruction, and a cloned effect on EVENT_BATTLED covers battle destruction, requiring that the attacker or the attack target be a Winged Beast you control which IsBattleDestroyed() and is still IsLocation(LOCATION_MZONE) and IsPosition(POS_FACEUP) - literally upstream's annotation 'Battle destroyed registers while the mosnter is on field'. The modern script routes both cases through the single destruction event using previous-state checks (IsPreviousControler, IsPreviousLocation, IsPreviousPosition, GetPreviousRaceOnField). Chronology unresolved.
